d:
Chhath tyauhar ke dauran thekuaa ka khas mahatv hai aur is pakvan ko behad shuddhata ke sath banaya jata hai. gehun ka aata, gur aur shuddh ghi thekuaa ke nirman men upyog men laya jata hai. mana jata hai ki rigved men apup ka ullekh milta hai, jise aate, ghi aur shahad ya any mithe padarthon se taiyar kiya jata tha.
